column1: # r2 reviewed 2026-10-26: kept 43, renamed 2, reverted 0 (plus 1 func_ named in review)

column3: Clears the 16 effect-slot active fields, four repeat-slot counters, and the effect-system state flag.

(n, bytes): copies n bytes, swaps bytes 1/2 into ascending order when n >= 3, then searches the 15 records of group bytes[0] in D_800C185C for one of length n with the same bytes; returns group<<8 | index; Player and 216E0 pass the entered element sequence, Magic_GetSpellRestrictionFlags takes the result

(spell id, value): bit 4 when the caster's level D_8007AA1C->unk24[group] is below the record's +0, bit 2 when the record's +2 mask lacks the field/battle bit (D_8008BE52&1), bit 1 when value (Player passes unk14->unk8) is below D_800C186E[length]; Player refuses the cast on 5 or nonzero

(caster, spell id, repeat index, flags): takes a free slot of the 16 effects D_80085F98 from the spell's record, queues the remaining repeats in D_80086358 (def +0x20 > 1), sets the start velocity, runs the record's target-select (D_8004ECB8) and placement (D_8004EC90) entries and Magic_CreateCastPresentation; called by Player (cast), Enemy (AEA0), Item_UseSpell and the repeat queue
Copies actor X/Z and chooses actor Y or ground-height minus model radius for the effect position.
Copies actor X/Z and chooses ground height or actor Y plus half model height for the effect position.
Copies actor X/Z and sets Y from upper model extent plus configured offset.
Rotates a positive local Z offset by actor yaw and places the effect at the actor's middle height.
Rotates a positive local Z offset by actor yaw and places the effect at its upper height.
Rotates a negative local Z offset by actor yaw and places the effect at its upper height.
placement entry 6 of D_8004EC90: uses the effect's target when set (else the caster) and copies its X/Z; Y = model-type-1 centre minus radius, +100*scale for model type 2, else the actor's y
Chooses random radius and yaw, rotates the offset, and places it around the actor.
placement entry 8: distance = caster-target distance (enemy caster, unk5E&1) or 10*radius*scale, places the effect at the caster plus the yaw-rotated offset (1.5*d, d), at the caster's lower point
Rotates a 380-unit local Z offset and adds scaled X/Y/Z offsets to actor position.
Advances repeat schedules and all 16 active effects, resolves target hits, updates linked visuals, and handles effect-system end state.
Steers velocity toward a target, applies optional gravity, integrates position, and handles ground contact.
Integrates vertical velocity with optional gravity, handles ground contact, and follows target X/Z when configured.
Tests eligible player or enemy actors against the effect's position and configured radius, returning one in range.
Returns player or an active enemy after checking the slot-specific hit mask, without a distance test.

hit-test entry 2 of D_8004ECD0: calls Magic_FindTargetInRange only when the effect's flag bit 1 is set; that bit is set only on ground contact in Magic_MoveHomingEffect / Magic_MoveVerticalEffect (casts pass flags 0, 4 or 0x10) (r2: was Magic_FindTargetInRangeIfLanded)

hit-effect entry 0: damage from Magic_CalculateEffectDamage, halved when the caster has status bit 1; a 1-in-32 (enemy target: only with D_8007AA10&0x1000, 1-in-4 with 0x10000) bonus of +50% with a Fade_Start flash and flag 0x4000; then Enemy_TakeDamage or Player_TakeDamage

hit-effect entry 1 of D_8004ECDC: adds def +0xC percent of the max (model +6) plus a random quarter to the current value (model +4 for the player, slot +0xA for an enemy), capped at the max; shows the amount with Effect_AddFloatingNumber(target, 1, amt). +4/+6 are the HP pair (Item_UseRestore)
hit-effect entry 2: moves 11/64 of the target's value (enemy slot +0xC, or the player's model +8) to the other side (the player's model +8 capped at +0xA, or the enemy slot +0xC); shows the amount
Calls the player or enemy damage routine with amount zero and hit flag four.

hit-effect entry 7: an enemy target (unk5E&1) is cleared from the battle (status indicators cleared, unk50 = -1, D_8007B900--) unless D_8008BE52&0x100 (then the popup); the player takes damage of 4x the current value at model +4 (the HP that Magic_HealTarget refills)

hit-effect entry 8: when the actor's status bits (unk68->unk0) are set, clears them and resets the values the status entries change: unk8A = 0x10, unk88/unk86 from the model's +0xE/+0xC, unk90 = 1.0 (the shrink status's actor scale is not restored here)
Calls the module's effect-damage handler, then clears the target's statuses.

target-select entry 0 of D_8004ECB8: an enemy caster targets the player; otherwise picks the active enemy with the smallest absolute angle from the aim direction (the effect velocity when cfg +2 & 8, else the caster's yaw)
target-select entry 1: the player for an enemy caster, otherwise the first of the six enemy slots with unk7C != -1, or NULL
target-select entry 2: copies the caster (effect +0x24) into the target (+0x28)
Sets status bit one, halves actor scale, and starts the corresponding timed status effect.
Computes the amount used by the effect-damage handler from base value and caster or target level.
Scales visual dimensions from model size and calls the effect-object constructor.
Creates the cast visual, optional particle effect, and optional sound from the cast definition.
Creates a visual and optional sound for a timed effect step.
Creates a visual, optional particle effect, and optional sound at the hit actor.
Creates an effect visual, optional particle effect, and optional sound for the ground-contact callback.

Battle (1FA00) calls it per actor: decrements the timer of each of the 12 set status bits and on expiry clears the bit and restores what it changed (bit 1 scale, 4 unk8A, 0x10 unk90, 0x20 unk86, 0x400 unk88, 8 unk60 bit 1) (r2: was Magic_StepActorStatusTimers, Step as in the other per-tick names)
Tests the bit for an effect slot against the actor's recorded hit mask.
Sets the bit for an effect slot in the actor's recorded hit mask.
Clears the player hit mask and the six enemy hit masks.
Clears one effect-slot bit from the player and six enemy hit masks.

returns D_8004EDA4[r] = 0 when the effect hits (flag 4, or the 1..100 roll under cfg +0xE and then Player_RollHitOnEnemy / Enemy_RollHitOnPlayer for a target other than the caster), 1 or 2 for the two miss cases; Magic_UpdateEffects shows a miss (popup / Enemy_PlayMissEffect / Player_StartMissReaction) on nonzero
(effect, caster, status k): 1 with flag 4 or cfg +0x18 == 2; else Math_Rand(64) (enemy caster) or Math_Rand(32 / 28 with player flag 0x8000) under the per-status chance D_8004EDB0[k]
Assigns a random duration to the selected target status, with different ranges for self and other targets.

returns 0 when none of the 16 effect slots D_80085F98 is active (+4 != 0), else nonzero (16 minus the first active index); Player (3F50) waits for 0 before leaving its cast states and before acting in battle (r2: added)
